notes.title: Major Update: Frenzy Mode Difficulty Level UPGRADE + Spring Fist Mode
notes.content:
Hello community!

Here bringing you a new major update!

We have significantly increase the frenzy mode's game difficulty.

Come and challenge yourself and see how long you can survive! hehehe

There's more! There will be an additional play mode ready for you to experience! Enjoy the thrill of the Spring fist mode! Where you hand will now turn into a retractable spring fist, aim it correctly at the 'things'!

That's it for now, but heads up for an additional upcoming major update soon it will enable a local multiplayer mode for you and your friends&family to enjoy I Pay No Rent at the same time!!!

notes.title: Update to Oculus and Language Compatibility
notes.content:
Hi dear friends, we have updated the game to have an in-game menu for selecting language option and VR controller setting.

The game will remember your choice from last time and automatically launch the game with your last chosen options.

If you want to change the language or controller setting, there is an option for you to go back and change it.

Best!

-L&L Dev Team

notes.title: Oculus Compatibility Update
notes.content:
Hi Friends!

We have tested the game in Oculus and happy to announce that it should run without any problem in Oculus!

Avoid paying rent my friends :-)
